profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer at DMEA
profile.summary: Engineer wanting to make new technological innovations in the world

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: Work as an Embedded Software Engineer at the Defense Microelectronics Activity, developing C/C++ firmware for STM32 microcontrollers in support of Department of Defense applications. Develop, integrate, and test hardware drivers and embedded software for RF communication systems, including LoRa transceivers, custom UHF transmitters, and other RF platforms. Work with satellite communication systems and software-defined radios, with experience developing and testing custom Globalstar transmitters, receiver/sniffer applications, and communication systems operating across bent-pipe satellite networks.

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description: Developed software using C++ and Python to integrate USBL beacons with BlueROV underwater vehicles and ROS-based surface vehicles. Developed embedded software for PIC32 microcontrollers to monitor the health and integrity of underwater systems, as well as a bootloader application for MSP430 microcontrollers. Integrated a MySQL database for logging and tracking drone location data. Developed ROS drivers for Wave Glider platforms to enable waypoint navigation and vehicle control capabilities.

positions.title: Electronics Engineer Intern
positions.description: Develop hardware and firmware for DOD applications.

positions.title: Physics Student Assistant
positions.description: Facilitate discussion between students in physics' classroom in order for students to discover physics on their own.  Participate in meetings with physics professor to discuss potential improvements in the classroom.

projects.title: Micromouse
projects.description: A micromouse is a small robot vehicle that is able to navigate its way through on unknown maze. Used C Programming Language paired with Arduino software in order to control the micromouse.  Used flood fill algorithm in order to solve the maze.  Worked with infrared sensors to detect walls and stepper motors for precision positioning.  Created chassis to hold hardware using SolidWorks.  Made feedback system in order to correct robot's movements.

projects.title: Arduino Integrated Dumbbell
projects.description: This device keeps track of your workout progress by counting your reps (repetitions) and also displays the time you've spent on your workout on an LCD screen. The screen also changes color based on your progress.
